column1: # Scripts of the Deployer oracle (DeployerOracle.java) and of its Rust twin (deployer_cases.rs): id<TAB>script.
# A script is operations separated by ';', words by single spaces; \uXXXX is one UTF-16 unit and "" the empty string.
#   deploy PATH   Deployer.deploy(Deploy(PATH, dispatcher = "d<n>")), n = the order of the deploy operation (1-based)
#   find A/B/C    Deployer.lookup(Iterable): the elements are PATH.split("/", -1); "-" is no element at all
#   lookup URI    Deployer.lookup(ActorPath) of the path parsed from URI
# (A lone surrogate in a path is outside the &str domain of the Rust API, Q-X-17: no script uses one, which is why DL-41 does not exist.)
# Each operation prints one token: ok | ERR <Exception> [<message>] | some(<path>@<dispatcher>) | none
DL-01 a single wildcard as last element
column2: deploy /some/*; find some/x; find some; find some/x/y; find other/x
